summary: Issue #642: the practice bot can answer any action the engine offers and no card play scores below passing (AbilityIntent, BotProfile, BotContext, AttackPlanner, completer, Mendon's policies; the client keeps one BotContext per practice match and retries after a refused action). A soak harness (tests/L5R.AI.Tests/BotSoak.cs, docs/BOT_SOAK.md) plays random-deck bot-vs-bot matches over every wired card. It exposed engine bugs, each fixed with a regression test: Confusion at Court crash on a card-less Favor action; Encircled Terrain prompting a player with no Personality; Kakita Yusugi Proclaiming repeatedly; choices answered by one player (Harsh Choices, province reveal order, Offering Reverence, Either/Or, Tested Land) left with the other player holding priority, which stalled the match (PendingPriority.cs); The Price of Honor leaving a stale Either/Or prompt after its discard choice; Second City crashing when the players have different province counts; Moon's Imperative / Hawado discarding from a province's second slot. Shared: touches engine, AI and client under Mendon's standing authority (collaboration.json).
validation: Full Core suite 2377 PASS, 0 FAIL; AI suite 97/97, bot-policy 9/9, CI soak 2/2. Soak seeds 1-60: 59/60 finish, 0 stall/illegal/cap/exception. Soak seeds 1000-1399 (400 matches, before the later fixes): 372 finished, stall 1, cap 3, exception 5; all nine of those seeds re-run clean after the fixes. Soak seeds 3000-3149 (150 matches): 145 finished, 0 stall/illegal/exception, 2 cap (Tested Land priority, fixed afterwards and re-run clean). check_format and lint clean. NOT verified: no human playtest of the new bot and no native client check; rules readings in the spec are my interpretations (see PR).
remaining: Mendon to play against the bot and confirm the interpretations; engine action-list gaps from the soak (offered then refused: field-messenger-transfer, equip hosts, restricted attackers, etc.); wire the bot's own decklist (DeckAveragePersonalHonor) from practice setup; one more large soak after merge.
